rubrics.justification: Generally consistent with an expanded blastocyst and thinned zona, but it overstates confidence in identifying an A-grade ICM and cohesive TE from this single image; the described upper-right compact ICM is not clearly well-defined.
Thoroughly integrates age, ovarian reserve markers, low oocyte yield, tubal factor, sperm parameters, BMI, endometrium, and first-cycle status with embryo prognosis.

Reasoning is logical and internally consistent, with prognosis tied to morphology and patient factors; only minor overinterpretation of morphology and somewhat broad assumptions about expected oocyte yield.

Recommendations are largely evidence-based and consistent with standard IVF practice, including SET, caution about hydrosalpinx, and avoiding unproven add-ons; minor speculative protocol suggestions prevent a perfect score.
Provides clear practical next steps for current transfer and future cycle review, including luteal support, hydrosalpinx confirmation, stimulation review, and when to consider PGT-A.
